name: jsscope
description: A fast, ESLint-compatible scope analyzer for JavaScript and TypeScript, built on the jsparse binary AST.

scripts.bench: npm run build --workspace=jsparse && npm run build && node benchmarks/benchmark.js
scripts.conformance: npm run build --workspace=jsparse && npm run build && node scripts/conformance-js.mjs ../../node_modules 5000 && node scripts/conformance-ts.mjs ../../node_modules 5000
